No,
SpinLife
does not sell or distribute wearable medical devices
(such as smartwatches, continuous glucose monitors, or wearable ECG monitors). They focus strictly on large durable medical equipment and mobility products.
SpinLife
Core Product Focus
Mobility Scooters
: Three and four-wheel travel and heavy-duty scooters.
Wheelchairs
: Power and manual wheelchairs plus specialized pediatric options.
Patient & Vehicle Lifts
: Patient hoists, slings, and vehicle-mounted lifts.
Home Seating & Beds
: Lift chairs, hospital beds, and adjustable sleep surfaces.
Daily Living Aids
: Ramps, bath safety items, and walking aids.
SpinLife
If you are looking for a specific type of
wearable medical device
, let me know what you need to track or monitor, and I can help point you toward retailers or brands that carry it.
